test_normalize_workdir: test the cron.jobs._normalize_workdir function to validate absolute paths, reject relative paths, and expand tilde
test_create_job_workdir: test the cron.jobs.create_job function to verify workdir is stored, None is preserved, and invalid paths are rejected
test_update_job_workdir: test the cron.jobs.update_job function to set, clear with None or empty string, and reject invalid workdir values
test_cronjob_tool_workdir: test the tools.cronjob_tools.cronjob function for create and update JSON round-trip with workdir field in schema
test_tick_workdir_partition: test the cron.scheduler.tick function to verify workdir jobs run sequentially on main thread before parallel jobs
test_run_job_terminal_cwd: test the cron.scheduler.run_job function to verify TERMINAL_CWD is set and restored when workdir is present or absent
